The '''''Sonic Guide to Native Neimoidian''''' was a [[Book/Legends|text]] written by [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]]. It purported to instruct non-[[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] how to speak their guttural native [[Language/Legends|language]] known as [[Pak Pak/Legends|Pak Pak]]. That text was included in the packaging of a special [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] that was sold to [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] wanting to be able to communicate in the heavily accented language of the Neimoidian people. The document was later included in Baobab's manual [[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']], which was published in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].<ref name="GPBTG" />
